address: 10 Dongdi Second Road, Yuexiu, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: Since opening in 2018, this tiny shop has been jam-packed with diners, so expect to share a table with strangers at peak hours. It is named after a street in the owner's native Hong Kong and has nearly 30 types of claypot rice in dai pai dong style, plus three kinds of double-boiled soups. Try their claypot rice topped with assorted Cantonese preserved meats – and savour every grain enrobed in perfumed oil and the crispy crust on the base....
